title: Entropy mitigation instrumentation plan and dashboard UX notes
summary: Working doc: reduce 'signal entropy' across inference telemetry by tightening metric definitions, improved trace anchors, and a prioritized dashboard reshuffle to cut noisy widgets and focus operator actions.
problem_statement: Operator dashboards currently contain many high-cardinality, low-action signals that add noise during incidents and lengthen time-to-detect. This doc lays out a pragmatic instrumentation and UX plan to reduce entropy, preserve investigation fidelity, and enable faster operator decisions for tokenized inference workloads.
metrics_plan:
Goal: compress surface area while keeping root-cause fidelity. Proposals:
- Canonical metrics to keep: request_rate_per_model, p50_ttfk, p95_ttfk, kv_cache_hit_rate, kv_cache_tail_ratio (90th pct of misses), token_emit_rate, model_fallback_rate, tenant_error_rate.
- Deprecate or roll-up: per-endpoint token_latency_histogram -> keep quantile rollups (p50/p95/p99) and drop raw histograms for low-traffic models.
- Introduce 'investigation anchors': session_rebuild_id (lightweight, opaque id propagated in headers), call_path_tag (fanout|single|chain), and model_variant_label.
- Metric definitions: provide plain-language definition + instrumentation guidance in annotation for each metric (owner, unit, cardinality cap). Example: kv_cache_hit_rate = cached_kv_hits / total_kv_lookups (unit: ratio, cap: tag by model only).
- Alert guardrails: alerts should map to playbooks. New rule: no new high-cardinality alert without an investigation card.
- Sampling: adaptive sampling for token-level traces based on anomaly score and tenant weight; baseline sampling at 0.2% for low-risk traffic, 2% for high QPS models, 5% for flagged tenants.
tracing_notes:
Trace anchors & sampling strategy:
- Anchor spans: request_ingest -> routing -> model_inference -> kv_lookup -> token_emission -> response_assembly. Each span must record minimal semantic tags: model_sha, model_variant, sequence_length_bucket, session_rebuild_id.
- Span size policy: limit attached payloads (no full prompt unless explicitly opted in per investigator). Store prompt snapshots in a short-lived artifact store with tokenized fingerprints to preserve privacy.
- Adaptive trace stitching: when a low-latency outlier is observed, trigger retroactive trace capture for that session_rebuild_id for 2 minutes to capture multi-hop context.
- Trace sampling logic: deterministic always-capture for 1 in 10k requests tagged as canary or rollout candidate; probabilistic capture around SLA breaches.
- Redaction: PII/PHI must be redacted at ingestion; tracing libraries to run sanitizer hooks with KMS-enforced rules for Private deployments.
- Quick triage fields: top-level trace summary should include observed_latency_slice (cold_kv|hot_kv|compute|emit), memory_pressure_flag, and fallback_reason if applicable.
dashboard_notes:
Dashboard reshuffle & UX heuristics:
- Lane-first layout: top row shows platform-wide SLO health (minimally: global p95 latency, error budget burn rate, capacity pressure), second row shows model cohorts (compute-bound vs kv-bound), third row shows tenant-impacting signals.
- Widget culling criteria: prune panels with >10s median query or <1% operator usage in last 90 days unless tied to an existing runbook.
- Compact investigation cards: clicking a model tile opens a compact card with 3 quick-investigate actions: 'show recent traces', 'compare variant perf', 'replay prompt sample' (replay only for non-PII).
- Cost-aware panels: each dashboard lists approximate query-cost-per-minute to help PMs and ops prioritize.
- Multi-resolution mode: default dashboard shows 1h-24h; operator view toggles to 5m-1h with heavier sampling traces.
- Alert lenses: attach a checklist to each alert with likely culprits and suggested next commands (kv-warm, restart-worker, degrade-model).
- Migration path: deploy the new UX as an opt-in feature flag, collect operator feedback for 2 weeks, gradually flip for oncall rotation owners.
experiment_plan:
Small experiments to validate approach:
- Week 0-2: implement annotation metadata on 10 canonical metrics and add session_rebuild_id propagation for two high-QPS models. Collect baseline operator usage metrics.
- Week 3-4: enable adaptive sampling for traces on one model cohort; reduce histograms on low-traffic models. Measure reduction in dashboard panels and trace storage delta.
- Week 5-6: launch compact investigation cards behind flag for SRE team; run 3 operational drills and collect TL;DR feedback.
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in panels queried during incidents, 25% cut in trace storage growth, median incident TTD reduced by 10%.
privacy_and_compliance: Private deployments: ensure tracing payloads go through customer-managed KMS; provide an opt-out flag for prompt snapshot persistence. For hosted: default redaction at ingestion, retention tiers for trace artifacts (7d hot, 90d cold), and per-customer retention override with contract. Documented in confluence linked_artifacts.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risks:
- Over-pruning could remove signals needed for rare regressions -> mitigation: staged removal behind feature flags and canarying with runbooks pinned.
- Operators resist new UX -> mitigation: invite SREs and support on design reviews and run 2 workshops.
- Sampling misses signal-worthy traces -> mitigation: keep deterministic capture for rollouts and a small percentage of all requests for retrospective analysis.
